title: Divisor Tree
statementMd:
A *divisor tree* is a rooted tree that meets the following conditions:

- Each vertex of the tree contains a positive integer number.
- The numbers written in the leaves of the tree are prime numbers.
- For any inner vertex, the number within it is equal to the product of the numbers written in its children.

Manao has $*n*$ distinct integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$. He tries to build a divisor tree which contains each of these numbers. That is, for each $*a*_{*i*}$, there should be at least one vertex in the tree which contains $*a*_{*i*}$. Manao loves compact style, but his trees are too large. Help Manao determine the minimum possible number of vertices in the divisor tree sought.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 8$). The second line contains $*n*$ distinct space-separated integers $*a*_{*i*}$ ($2 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{12}$).

## Output

Print a single integer — the minimum number of vertices in the divisor tree that contains each of the numbers $*a*_{*i*}$.

## Note

Sample 1. The smallest divisor tree looks this way: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e0519897209211793a4ab5b4cab12aac147d5b92.png)

Sample 2. In this case you can build the following divisor tree: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f5a26b6a4dce4116a0a6fbee67c9630d8239b093.png)

Sample 3. Note that the tree can consist of a single vertex.
statementZhMd:
<statement>
一棵**因数树**是满足以下条件的有根树：

- 树的每个顶点中都包含一个正整数。
- 树的叶子中写入的数字都是质数。
- 对于任意内部顶点，其中的数字都等于其子节点中写入的数字的乘积。

Manao 有 $*n*$ 个互不相同的整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$。他尝试构造一棵包含这些数的因数树。也就是说，对于每个 $*a*_{*i*}$，树中至少应有一个顶点包含 $*a*_{*i*}$。Manao 喜欢紧凑的风格，但他构造的树太大了。请帮助 Manao 确定所求因数树可能具有的最少顶点数。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 8$）。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个互不相同的、以空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{*i*}$（$2 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{12}$）。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即包含所有给定数字的因数树的最少顶点数。

## 说明

样例 1。最小的因数树如下所示： ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e0519897209211793a4ab5b4cab12aac147d5b92.png)

样例 2。在这种情况下，可以构造如下因数树： ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f5a26b6a4dce4116a0a6fbee67c9630d8239b093.png)

样例 3。注意，树可以只由一个顶点组成。
</statement>
